name: _rtty_live
label: RTTY live decode (ad-hoc, not shipped)
ai_notes: Ad-hoc bring-up flowgraph proving the fldigi RTTY decoder on real off-air HF. SDRplay RSPdx, Antenna C (long wire). Tune the DIAL (USB suppressed carrier) ~1.5 kHz below the RTTY mark/space centre so the signal lands near fldigi's 1500 Hz RTTYsweetspot; AFC pulls in the rest. Headless: decode -> tracing target decoder::fldigi. Not in the catalog (catalog_visible:false) and gated out of the ship path.
